Name: (CR) Kisaa's Little Falls Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[size=3][center][i]﻿﻿Welcome to [b]Little Falls[/b], a cozy hill farm with rivers. My very first mod![/i][/center][/size]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Choose before starting a new save!
[*][b]Diggable grass tiles: [/b]There are designated crop plots prepared, but feel free to dig in anywhere!
[*][b]Respawning hardwood stumps: [/b]If you don't want this, [i][b]delete the [FTM] CR Little Falls Farm folder.[/b][/i]
[*][b]Supports 4-person multiplayer![/b]
[*][b]Farm appearance customization[/b]
[/list]
[size=3]Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easier in-game customization.

[/size][i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box.
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (20x Parsnip Seeds), Florist (15x Tulip Bulbs, 2x Bee House)
[*][b]Grassy Hill: [/b]Changes terrain on the west smaller hill from dirt to grass. Won't affect diggability!
[*][b]Grassy Pet Bowl: [/b]Changes terrain under default pet bowl location from dirt to grass.
[*][b]Watering Hole: [/b]Toggles the small pond on the lower left corner of farm on/off. For players who want to keep animals in that area without building wells when you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6196]Animals Need Water[/url]﻿ mod, or as easier water source in multiplayer.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue, Eemie.
[b][u]Not Compatible[/u] [/b]with mods that replace the Standard Farm.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip [i]"Kisaa's Little Falls Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Do not install this mod on an existing save file, as it will result in wrong debris/object/building spawns.
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any issues back to me.
[/list]
[size=3]As this is my first ever mod, expect some issues I might have missed during playtesting. Please report any bugs here on Nexus, or you can reach out to me (crystalinerose) in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Modding Discord[/url]﻿ for a faster response.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod!

[b][size=3][i]Mods used in screenshots:﻿[/i][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage (Unofficial)[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5168]Wildflower Grass[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20710]Pet Bowl Recolor[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][/b]
